worldcombat.skill.charm.summary: Cuddle up to a foe you can see and charm its fighting spirit away, harshly lowering its Attack; cover blocks the gaze. You may instead blow a kiss: a slow, straight-flying heart pellet that reaches farther, but only drops one stage on the first foe it hits; a friend or a block intercepts and shatters it.
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.0: Soften a physical threat that has closed in
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.1: Blunt an attacker's blows before it reaches you
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.2: Top up the drop with a kiss from a little farther
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.0: On a hit the target loses %1$s Attack stage(s) and carries the Smitten mark for %2$s; while marked, a partner will not use Charm-family moves on it again. The Attack drop persists on its own and is not restored when the mark ends.
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.1: Charm range %1$s; cover beyond that cannot be reached.
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. The gaze must be seen and is blocked by cover; single target only.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.off: Cuddle: you must get close, but it removes 2 stages and lingers longer.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.on: Blown kiss: releases a slow, straight-flying heart pellet that reaches much farther, but removes only 1 stage on the first foe it hits, lingers shorter, and winds up and cools down slower; a friend or a block intercepts the pellet.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.flight: The kiss flies at %1$s blocks/tick with a %2$s pellet; it is slow enough to sidestep and can be intercepted by a friend or a block.
worldcombat.skill.charm.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
When on, releases a slow, straight-flying heart pellet: much longer range, but only 1 Attack stage on the first foe it hits, shorter duration, and slower windup and cooldown; a friend or a block intercepts the pellet. Off means you must get close for 2 stages that last.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.ma: The companion only considers charm while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.op: Countering charms only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime charms at any threat.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.pr: When on, a foe whose Attack clearly beats its Special Attack is prioritized; off treats every threat alike.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.le: When on, the companion may leave its post to charm under a Hold order.
